name: parseUrlParameters
requirements: Input must be a valid string
Extract all query parameters from the URL string
Return an object where keys are parameter names and values are parameter values
Support multiple values for the same key by returning an array
Handle URLs with hash fragments correctly by ignoring everything after '#'
edge_cases: URL contains special characters or encoded spaces
Input is only a query string without a base URL
example:
const params = parseUrlParameters('https://example.com/api?user=dev&id=123&tag=js&tag=node#section1');
console.log(params); // { user: 'dev', id: '123', tag: ['js', 'node'] }
